title: Estimating Implicit Regularization in Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.05436v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep learning systems are known to exhibit implicit regularization (alt. implicit bias), favoring simple solutions instead of merely minimizing the loss function. In some cases, we can analytically derive the implicit regularization -- connecting it to an equivalent penalty that augments the learning objective. However, modern deep learning systems are complex, carrying modifications to the training procedure and architecture (e.g. early stopping, minibatching, dropout) whose effects are not always directly interpretable. Although estimating the resulting implicit regularization could aid theorists in algorithm design and practitioners in interpreting their hyperparameter choices, this problem has received little direct attention. It is also tractable: regularization makes weight updates deviate from loss gradients, promising a signal for identifying implicit bias. translated_title: 估计深度学习中的隐式正则化
translated_abstract: 众所周知，深度学习系统会表现出隐式正则化（也称隐式偏差），即倾向于选择简单的解，而不仅仅是最小化损失函数。在某些情况下，我们可以通过解析方法推导出这种隐式正则化——将其与增广学习目标的等价惩罚项联系起来。然而，现代深度学习系统十分复杂，包含对训练过程和架构的各种修改（如早停、小批量训练、dropout 等），这些修改的效果并不总是能够被直接解释。尽管估计由此产生的隐式正则化既有助于理论研究者进行算法设计，也有助于实践者理解其超参数选择，但这一问题很少受到直接关注。同时，这一问题也是可处理的：正则化会使权重更新偏离损失梯度，这为识别隐式偏差提供了有希望的信号。在此，我们提出了一类梯度匹配方法，可用于……
tldr: 本文提出基于梯度匹配的估计方法，利用正则化导致权重更新偏离损失梯度这一信号，来量化深度学习系统（包括早停、小批量、dropout 等修改）中隐式正则化的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes gradient matching methods to estimate the implicit regularization of deep learning systems, exploiting the signal that regularization causes weight updates to deviate from loss gradients, thereby accounting for complex training modifications such as early stopping, minibatching, and dropout.
